en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a village with a prominent church on a low hill to the left, surrounded by forest. In the foreground is a dirt road lined with wooden fences, with a horse‑drawn cart, a few pedestrians, and a dog. Wooden houses and farm buildings are scattered across gently rolling fields. There is a telegraph pole by the road. At the bottom margin, partially overexposed handwritten and printed text appears.
